nodes.label: VibeCoder Favicon PNG Asset
nodes.rationale: A 19 by 19 pixel PNG stored at the conventional favicon path and optimized with alpha transparency for compact browser-facing display.

nodes.label: VibeCoder Brand Mark
nodes.rationale: The asset is the Vibecoder repository's favicon and is positioned to function as a compact product identity mark, although the image itself contains no explicit wordmark.

nodes.label: Abstract Diagonal Ribbon Mark
nodes.rationale: The visible mark consists of broad angular dark-gray bands separated by narrow negative-space channels, producing an abstract geometric symbol at very small scale; the exact intended letterform is uncertain.

nodes.label: Monochrome Dark-Gray Design
nodes.rationale: All visible opaque pixels use closely related charcoal-gray values around #343434, with no distinct accent colors.

nodes.label: Transparent Alpha Canvas
nodes.rationale: The PNG declares an alpha channel and contains fully transparent pixels, leaving the mark without a solid rectangular background.

nodes.label: Browser Site Identification
nodes.rationale: The favicon filename, public web-asset location, compact dimensions, and simplified mark strongly indicate use for browser-tab, bookmark, or shortcut recognition.
